title: Grade 3 Math — Thu, Jun 12
description: Fractions — Day 4 of 5: Comparing fractions and equivalent fractions
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which is bigger — 3/4 or 1/4?
questions.explanation: Both have 4 equal parts. 3 parts is more than 1 part, so 3/4 > 1/4.

questions.question: Which is smaller — 2/5 or 4/5?
questions.explanation: Both have 5 equal parts. 2 parts is less than 4 parts, so 2/5 < 4/5.

questions.question: Which is the same as 1/2?
questions.explanation: 2/4 = 1/2. Both mean half of the whole.

questions.question: Rohan ate 3/8 of a pizza. Meena ate 5/8. Who ate more?
questions.explanation: Both fractions have 8 parts. 5 > 3, so Meena ate more.

questions.question: 2/6 is the same as ___.
questions.explanation: 2/6 = 1/3. Divide both top and bottom by 2: 2÷2 = 1, 6÷2 = 3.

questions.question: Which fraction is equal to 1 whole?
questions.explanation: When numerator = denominator, the fraction = 1 whole. 5/5 = 1.

questions.question: Put in order from smallest to biggest: 1/4, 3/4, 2/4.
questions.explanation: Same denominator (4), so compare numerators: 1 < 2 < 3. Order: 1/4, 2/4, 3/4.

questions.question: Which is greater — 1/3 or 1/4?
questions.explanation: When numerators are the same, the smaller denominator = bigger fraction. 1/3 > 1/4.

questions.question: 4/4 is equal to ___.
questions.explanation: 4 out of 4 parts = all of it = 1 whole.

questions.question: A classroom has 20 children. 10 are girls. What fraction are girls?
questions.explanation: 10 out of 20 = 10/20 = 1/2. Half the class is girls.

questions.question: Which two fractions are equivalent?
questions.explanation: 2/4 = 1/2 (divide both by 2). They represent the same amount.

questions.question: Anita has a ribbon 6 m long. She cuts off 2/6. How many metres does she cut?
questions.explanation: 2/6 of 6 m = 2 m. (Each sixth = 1 m; 2 sixths = 2 m.)

questions.question: Which fraction is bigger — 2/3 or 2/5?
questions.explanation: Same numerator (2). The smaller denominator (3) gives bigger pieces. So 2/3 > 2/5.

questions.question: A garden has 8 rows. Tomatoes grow in 3 rows. What fraction is tomatoes?
